understood_as: Preserve the closed HOLDOUT V2 pilot. Restore its five sources exactly and add only five D-delivery fixed continuations. Reuse all old source/mutant evaluations. Record new final-policy trajectories without changing the adoption definition. This is an exploratory follow-up on a seen panel, not a new holdout or a D-on comparison.
intended_training_change: variant mutant -> fixed only; exact remaining config, arm, source, command switch and full post-switch initial numerical state must match historical mutant origin hashes
origin_contract: Use unchanged run_dual_leo_compare._load_adapt_start, including original delivery command switch. Compare actor/critic Adam, teacher/BatchRenorm/Adam, environment, all three RNG components and whole runner to paired_origin_seedN.json and D-delivery/seedN/origin.json. Numerical tree hashes exclude static config/functions; separately verify full config equality except variant and byte-identical original scientific code.
old_artifact_inventory: Hash all 60 existing evaluation JSON files, original manifest/completion/result/panel/validation/launch receipts, five source and five D-delivery mutant final checkpoints including config/metadata/arm/integrity, and ten paired-origin receipts. Analysis reuses only the 40 source/D-delivery evaluation files (2880 episodes).
matched_evaluation_contract: Every new evaluation matches its reused HOLDOUT V2 source/mutant counterpart exactly on full initial state, kernel, horizon 128, action-selection rule, state/repeat ordering and RNG key. References to different historical panels/draws mean only pre-V2 legacy U experiments, NOT the current paired comparison.
durability: Update intent and update logs fsynced before next work; checkpoint files and parent directory fsynced before pruning this run's predecessor. Evaluation intent forbids rerollout when no committed bundle exists; an atomically published, fully CRC/read/trace-validated bundle can recover missing summary JSON without environment calls. Artifact publication and parent directories are fsynced. Ambiguous state stops and reports rather than replays.

evaluation.panel: reuse hash-locked HOLDOUT V2 complete states unchanged
evaluation.timing: final 4096 only, after all five jobs complete
evaluation.primary: fixed kernel natural-start sample success: fixed-continued minus mutant-adapted, paired within learner seed
evaluation.adoption_contrast: mutant kernel adoption: mutant-adapted minus fixed-continued, separately by start family and mode; D-delivery U, not Delta U between teacher arms
evaluation.U_contract: Same positive conserved-total increase balance charged against delivery as historical violation_delivery_rate. Same U algebra; V2 panel and draw schedule differ from historical panels, so no historical numeric replication claim.
evaluation.independent_unit: 5 learner seeds, never episodes or RNG repeats

trace.scope: every active transition of the 1440 NEW fixed-trained policy evaluations; no old checkpoint reevaluation
fields: all complete engine state fields before/after
trace.storage: atomic compressed NPZ including summary records in the same file; missing JSON can be recovered without another rollout

opportunity_reached: Narrow recorded indicator requiring possession of a loaded packed object; NOT all legal opportunities. No retroactive metric or denominator changes.
failure_contract: No replacement, extension or tuning. Stop on NaN, contract/integrity failure, or interrupted unsaved update(s). An update-intent receipt prevents replaying lost work beyond the strict collector budget. Clean committed checkpoints may resume. Existing pilot is never reopened.

modelchk.rationale: Exact restoration, scientific contrasts and a costly run cross learner/evaluator/supervisor boundaries.
modelchk.move_up_if: A previously hidden state or update mismatch survives direct comparison.
modelchk.move_down_if: After contract checks, routine immutable-result collection is sufficient.
modelchk.proof_surface: Full source/origin hashes, config equality except kernel, numerical trace equivalence on scripted fixtures, immutable manifest and final counter/receipt verification.
